rule: Backend writes Mongo. Frontend paints Mongo. The only coupling is the HTTP API in contracts/api.json. Frontend never imports pymongo. Matcher never imports FastAPI. Search never upserts orders.

folders.contracts/: shared types. both sides may read. nobody else defines types.
folders.backend/api/: FastAPI. console and OpenClaw call this. OpenClaw never gets a Mongo URI.
folders.console/: one web app, three panes. talks only to /api.

write_owners.orders: ingest/heartbeat via store. supervisor flag only through POST /orders/:id/flag
write_owners.pipeline_events: store.emit() only. append-only. every other write must call this.

frontend_writes: POST /api/orders/:id/flag  (supervisor marks invalid — this is the website indicating red)

voice.shows: text/voice processing as the agent hears, parses, and asks

database.shows: objects appearing in Mongo, with flagged/invalid rows painted red
database.red_when: orders.status == flagged OR an open alert on that order_id. Red is a CSS class, not a fourth backend.

search.shows: agent walking citations to find where the mistake started
